narrative.overview: ServeAI should feel like a serious player’s annotated practice journal translated into a native iPhone interface: quiet, direct, and specific. It borrows the editorial hierarchy and material restraint of the Ouranos DTS system without copying its product structure. The interface makes the evidence and next coaching action easy to read; it never uses visual spectacle to imply scientific certainty.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial headings paired with plain, high-legibility body copy.
One muted grass accent, used sparingly for actions and active state.
Flat sections and hairline dividers instead of card-on-card scaffolding.
Transparent evidence language and native iOS behavior.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Grass Note carries the primary action and active analysis state; a screen does not add decorative competing accents.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, controls, and status copy use sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A border, tonal fill, or whitespace is enough; never stack all three plus a shadow.

dos: Do foreground the next useful coaching action.
Do show insufficient visibility instead of inventing precision.
Do use whitespace and rules to create hierarchy.
Do preserve native controls, accessibility semantics, and system navigation.
donts: Don't use neon gradients, glowing rings, gradient avatars, or multicolor progress tracks.
Don't label deterministic or heuristic output as a personified Coach AI.
Don't turn every row or section into a rounded card.
Don't use all-caps hype copy as a substitute for hierarchy.
